legal.privacy.body: We only collect what is needed: account, photos and scripts you upload, and usage data. We use third-party AI to generate videos, only with your consent. You can export, correct or delete your data at any time in Settings. We keep raw videos for 90 days, logs for 30 days and audit trails for 12 months.
legal.terms.body: You are responsible for the content you upload and publish and must hold the rights to photos and voices. Using the app for scams, misleading content or content that breaks platform rules is prohibited. Plans, credits and the marketplace fee follow the rules shown in the app. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms.

help.title: Help center
help.q1: How does the video keep the same product in every scene?
help.a1: Each scene starts from the previous scene's last frame and your reference photos. If visual drift is detected, the scene is regenerated.
help.q2: How much does dubbing in other languages cost?
help.a2: Each language costs 5 credits. The original version stays intact and you choose which one to publish on each platform.
help.q3: How do I delete my account and data?
help.a3: In Settings > My data. The account is deactivated and permanently erased after 30 days; you can cancel during that period.
help.a4: See the message on the platform. Reconnect the account if the session expired and tap Try again only on that platform.
help.contact.sent: Message sent (simulated). We will reply by email.
help.sla: Reply within {{h}} business hours. Business plan: within 4 h.
